_comment: The two NASB editions Scripture Alone is licensed to distribute, each under its own Distribution
Permission Agreement with The Lockman Foundation, effective 2026-10-01. Everything a reader sees
about the translation comes from here, never from the source file, so a package cannot carry one
edition's text under the other's name or notice. `package_translation.py licensed` refuses a
store whose John 3:16 does not read the way this edition's does.
Notices are copied from the agreements word for word, line breaks included. Do not edit them
without a written change from Lockman: the agreement makes them a condition of the licence.
Policy: system text-to-speech is not a hand-off and is always allowed (it renders live and keeps
nothing, which is what the agreements permit). allowExternalHandoff is false, which turns off
the Mi Speaks Studio voice: it renders a recording and leaves a file behind, which they forbid.
